source_snapshot.procedure: Introduction says NVMe RAID rebuild LED, numbered action only inserts SSD and checks Present LED.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Three distinct states require authoritative branch and vendor-supported safe rebuild/recovery.

old_problem: Rebuild, Present and Locate LED triggers were conflated without RAID level, supported command, fault/replacement sequence or guaranteed recovery.
disposition_reason: The source contains irreducible operation-semantic conflict: genuine rebuild is a stateful data-risk workflow, insertion tests Present, and Locate is a manual-identification state. ED-01 forbids rebuild on RAID0, while no redundant disposable array, controller authority or recovery is supplied. Choosing a branch would invent or delete coverage.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row100 all18 XLSX cells and history2709.
Preserved all three conflicting state references rather than relabeling insertion or Locate as Rebuild.
Applied ED-01 RAID0 prohibition and required vendor/controller authority; no RAID, LED or physical action occurred.

test_case.test_name: NVMe RAID LED state validation pending Rebuild/Present/Locate authority
test_case.purpose: After source authority, validate the selected LED state or split separately identified variants without substituting one trigger for another.
required_package: Source-owner decision selecting Rebuild, Present, Locate or distinct variants
Vendor/controller/backplane LED state specification and supported CLI/version
If Rebuild: non-RAID0 disposable redundant array, exact member/replacement serial-slot map and data-loss approval
Vendor-supported degrade/replacement/rebuild trigger, progress/completion and abort criteria
Operator photos, backup/OOB, completion-or-rollback recovery and invalid-run policy
test_case.test_command: Do not start locate, insert/remove media or alter an array. After authority, execute only the selected state-specific vendor procedure. A Rebuild variant must first prove redundant non-RAID0 disposable topology, exact controller/member/replacement identity and recoverable supported trigger; correlate controller state/progress with timestamped physical LED evidence through completion and healthy restoration.
test_case.expected_result: Only the authoritative state is triggered, the specified LED pattern/timing matches controller evidence, and any approved rebuild completes with a healthy redundant array and no data/platform error.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS is impossible until state identity and authoritative expected LED/recovery are approved. Present or Locate evidence cannot pass Rebuild; RAID0 rebuild is prohibited.
safety_gate: Never rebuild RAID0 or an unknown/production array.
No fault, pull, replacement or CLI action without exact stable identities and explicit destructive approval.
Require vendor-supported controller command, backup, OOB and complete recovery path.
Abort on wrong member/slot, additional degradation, data/health error or lost controller visibility; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: State/variant authority and vendor LED specification
Exact supported state trigger and controller progress
Timestamped physical LED photos/video correlated to state
Completion health, logs, data integrity and recovery disposition
test_case.recovery: If wrong state or member is selected, stop before further mutation, preserve controller/slot/LED/event evidence, do not insert/remove or force another rebuild automatically, and have the RAID owner execute the vendor-approved completion or rollback plan until redundancy and data health are proven.

source_conflict.reason: Rebuild, Present and Locate remain distinct unapproved operation branches.

blocked.reason: Source/controller owner can provide branch authority and safe procedure; review documents the execution prohibition meanwhile.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: After branch decision, bind vendor CLI/spec, array/member topology, LED states, approval and recovery.
pending.execution_status: ENGINEERING DECISION RETAINED; NO RAID OR LED ACTION EXECUTED
pending.owner: RAID testcase, storage platform and controller owners.
pending.unlock_condition: Approve state identity/split and, for Rebuild, a supported non-RAID0 disposable recovery contract.

project_authority: State identity and OEM controller/recovery semantics require project authority.
